title: restart-comfy destroys any in-flight generation - the needs-restart gate never checks the queue
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-467 (the 1.4 smoke umbrella) - surfaced 2026-08-09 during its live Pod session, listed in tasks/MPI-467/brief.md.

CONFIRMED CAUSE OF A LOST SMOKE OP, and reproduced live by the user 2026-08-09 ("as soon as it hot stored the model, it said it was restarting ComfyUI because it added new nodes... It gave me a toast with that").

THE CHAIN, all four hops read:
  remote custom-node install completes
    -> server emits SSE comfy:needs-restart {remote: true}   (downloadManager)
    -> js/services/downloadService.js:724  state.remoteComfyNeedsRestart = true
    -> js/services/comfyController.js:543  gate fires on the next dispatch
    -> toast "Loading new nodes - restarting the remote engine..."
    -> POST /proxy/restart-comfy -> wrapper ComfyManager.restart() -> proc.terminate()

THE DEFECT: the gate restarts UNCONDITIONALLY. It never reads the queue, so proc.terminate() can land on a prompt that is mid-sample. comfyController retries ITS OWN dispatch afterwards, so the user who triggered it is covered - but ANY OTHER in-flight prompt is destroyed with no error, no toast and no log line. User-facing: a queued batch silently loses work.

WHAT IT COST: minimax-h3/t2v_ms in the second GPU matrix (2026-08-08 ~19:55Z). The smoke runner POSTs straight to /proxy/prompt and never passes through this gate, so it had no idea a restart was coming; it polled a dead prompt_id for 15 minutes and reported "timed out after 15 min", which read as a slow model and sent a whole session hunting a model bug that did not exist. The op was later PROVEN HEALTHY at 216s on the same graph and Pod (MPI-467 validation.md).

WHY IT IS PROVABLY A REQUESTED RESTART AND NOT A CRASH: wrapper.py ComfyManager._supervise() answers an unexpected ComfyUI exit with os._exit(1), and start.sh ends in `exec python -m uvicorn` with no respawn loop, so a crash takes the whole container down. Six ops passed on that Pod afterwards. Only POST /wrapper/restart-comfy can respawn ComfyUI while the Pod lives.

FIX DIRECTION: refuse or defer the restart while queue_running is non-empty (GET /proxy/queue already exists and is a plain passthrough of ComfyUI's {queue_running, queue_pending}), or drain first and tell the user. Whatever the shape, a restart must never silently discard someone else's prompt. MPI-467 has already landed the DETECTION half in the runner: an orphaned prompt now fails in ~30s naming this mechanism instead of timing out at 15 minutes.

attention.reason: Toast confirmed 2026-08-09 20:02Z by a real-pixel probe on the live app: mpi-toast--warning with the exact refusal string, zero crash dialogs. Guard itself was proven live at 19:00Z. Nothing left.
